notes.title: English Version Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36331104/5d62caa3cced6cda5aaa98c2be8715fa058446c4.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Our English Publisher Kikai Digital has completed the localization of ‘The Warmth Between Us’. 

You can now experience the game’s story and UI in English.

Feel free to discuss about our game in the communities forum, or leave a review if you like our game and want to see more localizations, so that we could bring more stories over to the English communities for your enjoyment. 

Thank you!

notes.title: 《十天的溫度》將於5月15日正式上線！
notes.content:
《十天的溫度》將於5月15日正式上線！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36331104/027a6eebc941fa9a9096f82e2e1025cf6db8e075.jpg[/img]

大家好！
本遊戲將於5月15日正式上線！

這是一段講述溫度的故事，是一個短篇細緻的視覺小說──
希望這個故事能夠觸動你的心弦，留下深刻的記憶！

※　英文版計畫正進行中，敬請期待！
　　The English localization of the game is coming soon. Please stay tuned!
